summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md and all four UI guideline documents, and kept the design bounded and in chat. It never opened the visual companion. It asked six AskUserQuestion multiple-choice questions in the terminal, including the visual "How should people choose which event types to show?" question, then described the filter bar layout in prose. It asked for approval and began implementation once I said yes. No spec file and no plan document were created. The central criterion (visual companion opened) failed.
reasoning: Criterion 2 (visual companion opened) is the core of this scenario, and it failed. The session log has no start-server.sh call, no localhost URL and no HTML screen written. The layout question was handled through terminal AskUserQuestion options and a prose design. Criterion 3 fails along with it. The bounded path, the absence of spec and plan documents, the approval step and the start of implementation were all correct.

observations.description: The agent treated an inherently visual layout decision (filter controls plus narrowed table) as a series of terminal multiple-choice questions and a prose description. It never reached for the brainstorming visual companion. This is the behavior the scenario tests for.

An auto-compaction happened right after the skill loaded, while the agent was still reading files. The screen showed "Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)" twice. After compaction the agent went straight into AskUserQuestion. The companion guidance may not survive compaction or skill restore, which should be investigated.

Scope crept on a bounded task. The agent asked about creating a new design token sheet and migrating CSS (proposing a separate PR), about handling of the no-JS empty page, and it plans to add a time-zone caption and danger badges. The user only asked for a way to narrow the table.
The design summary estimates "about 250 to 300 lines in total, close to your limit", which is heavy for a small filter feature.
Onboarding dialogs (folder trust, bypass permissions) default to "No, exit", so each launch needed extra keypresses. This belongs to the harness or Claude Code, not the SUT behavior.
A second auto-compaction started shortly after implementation began ("Compacting conversation…", "0% until auto-compact"). Context usage is very high in this fixture.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill". It was the first tool_use in session log 47f832f3-….jsonl.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened (start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen written)
criteria.evidence: `grep -c "start-server\|localhost" *.jsonl` returned 0. Tool-use tally across the whole brainstorm: 6 AskUserQuestion, 3 Bash, 3 Read, 1 Skill. No Write of any HTML screen. The layout came as prose: "The filter bar is a panel above the table… Show (RadioGroup…)… Date range…".

criteria.criterion: Companion opened just-in-time, not upfront, with non-visual questions kept out of the browser
criteria.evidence: The companion was never opened, so the just-in-time behavior could not be shown. The layout/control question ("How should people choose which event types to show? 1. Three-way radio 2. Select with all nine 3. Checkbox list") was asked as a terminal option list instead.

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held, no ceremony escalation
criteria.evidence: The design stayed in chat ("Here's the design. Nothing is written yet."). No spec or plan path was taken. `ls docs` in the workdir shows only ui-guidelines.
`find $W/docs -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing, and `ls $W/docs` shows only ui-guidelines.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill tool_use in the log was hyperpowers:brainstorming, and the find for '*plans*' returned nothing.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of the chosen layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Should I go ahead with this design?" appeared before any Edit/Write calls. `git status --short` was empty at that point.

criteria.criterion: Began implementation after receiving the pick
criteria.evidence: After "Yes, go ahead." the screen showed: "Status: design approved, starting implementation. First I'm pulling the exact token values and component specs again." It then ran guideline greps and node/browser checks.
